?>

import json

trace=[

{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mbregex_stack_limit.phpt","function":"<global>","line":15,"var":"mbstring.regex_stack_limit","code":"ini_set('mbstring.regex_stack_limit', 30001);","note":"The stack limit is raised just enough to allow the deep backtracking path to proceed instead of failing early."},
{"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mbregex_stack_limit.phpt","function":"<global>","line":22,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_ereg('\\s+$', $s);","note":"The anchored greedy pattern is applied to the long whitespace input, driving the regex engine into the vulnerable compile/runtime state."},
{"step":4,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern","line":null,"var":"pattern","code":"The mbstring wrapper compiles the whitespace-anchor pattern before matching.","note":"Oniguruma receives the attacker-controlled pattern and prepares the automaton used by the matcher."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5518,"var":"NODE_QUANT","code":"case NODE_QUANT: r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"Compilation enters the quantifier-tuning path for the trailing-plus pattern, where empty-repeat bookkeeping is computed."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"The compiler determines the repeat body's emptiness/memory classification, which is the issue's key root condition."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"The recursive AST walker inspects the attacker-driven repetition tree and propagates memory-sensitive state."},
{"step":8,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"mb_ereg execution","line":null,"var":"match result","code":"mb_ereg('\\s+$', $s) executes the compiled regex against the whitespace buffer.","note":"The match runs with an elevated stack budget and can expose the heap-use-after-free read when the vulnerable state is exercised."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
PY

import json
print(json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json'))[3]['code'])
